body:
The model catalogue lists three Qwen3.5 Q4_K_M downloads: 0.8B (~530 MB), 2B (~1.3 GB), and 4B (~2.7 GB). Those are model-file sizes, not total storage or RAM requirements; Whisper is a separate download.

The app includes smaller model choices and memory checks, but I don't have a published mid-range-phone benchmark for task extraction, so I can't promise smooth performance or accuracy on a particular device. Which phone and RAM size are you considering?
